description: Defines the MDnsCache class for managing mDNS records, including caching, expiration, and record lookup functionalities.

classes.name: MDnsCache
classes.description: A cache for mDNS records, handling expiration, lookup, and record management.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: A key class representing a 3-tuple (type, name, optional) for identifying DNS records.

methods.name: UpdateDnsRecord
methods.description: Adds or updates an mDNS record in the cache.

methods.name: LookupKey
methods.description: Retrieves a record by its cache key.

methods.name: FindDnsRecords
methods.description: Finds records matching type and name, excluding expired records.

methods.name: CleanupRecords
methods.description: Removes expired records and invokes a callback for each removed record.

methods.name: RemoveRecord
methods.description: Removes a specific record from the cache.

methods.name: IsCacheOverfilled
methods.description: Checks if the cache exceeds its entry limit.

methods.name: set_entry_limit_for_testing
methods.description: Sets the cache entry limit for testing purposes.
